Flow

  1. Idea: the lead says what they want, and it lands on the board as one line.

  2. Plan: a planner writes the goal, the scope and the checks; the lead approves once.

  3. Board: each task has an owner and a verify line; every agent sees what is next.

  4. Build: an agent claims a task and works in its own workspace.

  5. Review: a second agent reads the diff and answers approve or changes.

  6. Ship: the approved commit merges, and the lead sees the result.

Do and don’t

  • DoUse the accent for the one primary action on a screen, and nowhere else.

    Don’tFill a whole card with a state colour; a dot and a word carry the state.

  • DoShow a task's state with a word and an icon beside its colour.

    Don’tAdd a second accent for emphasis; use weight, size or space.

  • DoTake every size from the type scale; body text at 16px.

    Don’tSet running text under 16px or wider than 70 characters.

  • DoSet secondary text in muted on surface: 6.44:1.

    Don’tPut muted text on the accent: 1.40:1, under AA.
